text.p: -- Merrill Lynch & Co said in a report it has reiterated its accumulate recommendation on shares of Brazilian state owned power firm Eletrobras.
-- "Eletrobras enjoys an enviable strategic position in the generation business, operating in the entire country," the brokerage said.
-- Moreover, the firm is likely to achieve greater efficiency from its expected corporate and operational restructuring as a result of its upcoming privatization, it said.
-- "Its privatization process offers some risk to minority shareholders," Merrill Lynch said. "Moreover, premature privatization and/or sales of assets may result in depressed sale prices."
-- Eletrobras' preferred B share was off 0.25 percent at 392 reais at 1543 local time/1843 EST on the Sao Paulo bolsa. Its common stock was up 0.13 percent at 377 reais.
